title: Win a two-dozen box of cookies!
intro: To say thank you for all the love, I'm giving away a two-dozen box of my cookies to 3 lucky winners. And that's not all: everyone who enters wins something.
prize: A two-dozen box of Ginger & Crumb cookies (24 cookies), baker's choice of flavours
eligibility: Open to residents of Ontario who are 18 or older and can pick up in Richmond Hill.
